mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( user_id -- 사용자 아이디 (소문자 저장) , user_pw -- 비밀번호 , user_name -- 이름 , role -- 권한 (회원가입은 무조건 USER) , status -- 계정상태 (기본 ACTIVE) , reg_date -- 최초등록일시 ) VALUES ( LOWER(#{userId}) , #{userPw} , #{userName} , 'USER' , 'ACTIVE' , NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_no AS userNo , u.user_id AS userId , LENGTH(u.user_pw) AS userPwLen , u.user_name AS userName , DATE_FORMAT(u.reg_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS regDate , ru.user_name AS regUserName , DATE_FORMAT(u.mod_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS modDate , IFNULL(mu.user_name, '--') AS modUserName , u.`role` AS role , u.status AS status FROM users u LEFT JOIN users ru ON u.reg_user = ru.user_no LEFT JOIN users mu ON u.mod_user = mu.user_no WHERE u.user_no = #{userNo}
